analysis: Tyler Huntley is now confirmed starting for Baltimore (Lamar Jackson ruled out Friday, ankle, didn't practice all week), and the market has fully caught up -- Atlanta opened as a 6-point road underdog and is now a 3.5-point home favorite, a real 9.5-point swing that's entirely explained by the news, not a mystery line move. With the injury priced in, the sim has this close to a coinflip (Falcons 55.7% win, home cover only 47.1%), i.e. fair, not an edge, at the current number.

One thing the model can't fully capture: Baltimore also lost DE Trey Hendrickson (finger, out), its top pass rusher. That's a defensive-not-offensive loss, so it isn't priced into the sim's own total (44.5, already a touch above the 43.5 market) -- the honest read is the total should probably sit a little higher still than that 44.5, since Atlanta's O-line will see a weaker Ravens rush with Hendrickson out. Not a clean enough number to size, but worth knowing before fading the total.
